Teleport to the nearby waypoint and go to the quest location.

Watch a cutscene where two Fatui inspect the supplies.
Afterwards, use the monitor to call another container, then enter it to sneak inside the Bureau.
Quest Objective: Enter and explore the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau

<color=#ffffff73>Upon entering this room, the quest will start.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>The inside of the Bureau has many puzzles and chests available for taking, but many are not necessary to complete this quest.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Getting to this spot,</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>will hear Fatui speaking about their leader obtaining a Proof of Cognoscenti.</color>

The player <color=#ffffff73>will come across Fatui stationed across the Bureau.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Sneaking through them is an option, but if</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>chooses to fight, reinforcements will arrive if</color> the player <color=#ffffff73>does not dispatch all enemies within 20 seconds.</color>

<color=#ffffff73>The next point of interest is this lift.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>Choose to "Go Up" in order to progress the quest.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>Breaking into the heavily guarded Fatui facility was unexpectedly easy...</color>
Quest Objective: Investigate the chests
Quest Objective: Talk to Paimon

Afterwards, interact with the container to progress.

Right after their defeat, a cutscene, before a second wave appears to face the player.

Use the Kuuvahki to steal a keycard from one of the guards, then open the door with it.

<color=#ffffff73>After talking with the girl, use the Cleaning Bot to get a nearby keycard, then go through the bot vent in this room.</color>
<color=#ffffff73>After bringing the keycard to the other side, exit controlling the bot and use</color> the player's <color=#ffffff73>own character to manipulate the keycard into coming in contact with the lock.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>You meet a girl named Netochka, who infiltrated the Design Bureau in search of the legendary "Proof of the Cognoscenti" left behind by Reed Miller, but was captured by the Fatui. To repay you for saving her, she resolves to make us her companions in the quest for the "Proof"...</color>

The shield must be fully damaged thrice before it deactivates.
Once that is done, the player simply needs to defeat him.

customize.text:
<color=#ece5d8>Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, Nod-Krai</color>
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>The massive facility on Paha Isle seems to hide many secrets...</color>
Quest Objective: Enter and explore the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau
<color=#ffffff>Chatty Fatuus:</color> Say, the good ol' Poruchik collecting the Proof of the Cognoscenti... Think that counts as an abuse of power for personal gain? I mean, we're here on a mission. The heck are we doing, digging holes for him like moles...
<color=#ffffff>Taciturn Fatuus:</color> What happens up there is none of our business.
<color=#ffffff>Chatty Fatuus:</color> Do you think reporting it to the higher-ups will do anything?
<color=#ffffff>Chatty Fatuus:</color> Cause it seems to me that they don't like Poruchik Raskolnikov up there either. Maybe my report's just the opportunity they'll need!
<color=#ffffff>Taciturn Fatuus:</color> You should keep these words to yourself.
<color=#ffffff>Chatty Fatuus:</color> Huh? What, are you trying to get ahead of me? That's low of you, real low!
<color=#ffffff>Taciturn Fatuus:</color> *sigh*...
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>Breaking into the heavily guarded Fatui facility was unexpectedly easy...</color>
Quest Objective: Investigate the chests
Quest Objective: Talk to Paimon
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> They're all empty! This is the only one left...
<color=#ffffff>Weary Voice:</color> We've looked up and down and haven't seen hide or hair of that thief. Where in the world could she be hiding...?
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> Maybe she's gotten what she wanted and already made the big escape?
<color=#ffffff>Weary Voice:</color> Haha. That's not gonna look good on our monthly reports, let me tell you... or Poruchik Raskolnikov's...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Someone's approaching. Let's hide! Um, that container looks like a good spot...
Quest Objective: Hide in the container nearby
Optional Dialogue: Interact with the last chest
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Never mind that now, let's find a place to hide before we get caught!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Quick, Traveler, scooch over a bit and make some room for Paimon...
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> Wah! Wh—What are you doing!?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> H—Huhh?
<color=#ffffff>For some reason, the container seems to already be occupied. It is also clear that the current occupant is most displeased to have uninvited guests...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ow-ow-ow! Traveler, are you okay?
<color=#ffffff>Furious Fatuus:</color> ...What the— what hole did you all crawl out from!?
<color=#ffffff>Calm Fatuus:</color> Look, isn't that the thief we're looking for?
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> ...Give it back! Y—You... That's my treasure! Give it back!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wh—What treasure? We didn't touch anything... We haven't even opened the last chest.
<color=#ffffff>Furious Fatuus:</color> Do you take us for fools? Putting on this "uneven spoils split" act in front of us...
<color=#ffffff>Calm Fatuus:</color> We'll take them all in — both her and her accomplices.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh? W—Wait! We don't even know her!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: I'm here on a Harbinger's orders.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Calm Fatuus:</color> Pick a more convincing lie, would you?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: I was passing by and saw the chests...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Furious Fatuus:</color> That still makes you a trespasser. And we arrest those too!
Quest Objective: Defeat the Fatui
Quest Objective: Talk to the mysterious girl
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hey! Where do you think you're going?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Oh, you weasel! Trying to ditch us!
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> S—Say what you want! A true master thief only has her eyes on the treasure. I couldn't care less about anything else!
<color=#ffffff>V1:</color> ...That way, hurry!
<color=#ffffff>V1:</color> ...Got... Stay put...
Quest Objective: Defeat the Fatui
Quest Objective: Look for a way to exit the room
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Phew! Finally, we're safe... at least for now?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ugh, just our rotten luck! Paimon never would've guessed that the container... y'know, contained a thief the Fatui were chasing!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> We wouldn't be in such a mess if it weren't for her. Great, now the chest is gone, and we had to fight the Fatui...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Oh and, and! She even accused us of taking some treasure of hers. Lies! Lies and slander! Ugh, the more Paimon thinks about it—!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Speaking of...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> ...What's this?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Something I swiped in the dark just now.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> ...Huh!?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Is this the treasure she mentioned? Uh, what should we do now?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Let's take it to the lost and found.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Yeah... wait no! We don't even know if there is one around here, and, even if there were, it's not like we can just waltz in there, much less her!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Let's just leave it here and pretend we didn't see anything.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Mm-hmm, maybe she'll come back and look for it... but will she really?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hmm... Paimon wouldn't have cared as much if it were just an item from a chest no one owns...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> We should find a way to return it... A—As long as it's returned to its rightful owner, everything will be fine!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> But we've probably caught the attention of the Fatui here, so let's keep it on the down-low to make things easier, yeah?
Optional Dialogue: Interact with the locked door
<color=#ffffff>Locked Door:</color> (It won't budge at all. Looks like there's no way to open it...)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Not sure if there's another way out. Let's keep looking.
Quest Objective: Look for the owner of the lost item
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> Just lock her up here? Is that what we're doing?
<color=#ffffff>Weary Voice:</color> Yep. Poruchik Raskolnikov's orders.
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> ...Did you say "Raskolnikov"?
<color=#ffffff>Weary Voice:</color> That's "Poruchik Raskolnikov" to you, thief. Show some respect.
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> Forget about her. Where's the chest? Have you delivered it to the archives?
<color=#ffffff>Weary Voice:</color> Oh, Bakunin's on leave today. I bet he's downing another cup at The Flagship right now.
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> He sure knows how to enjoy life... Let's leave the chest in the dormitory for now and worry about it tomorrow.
<color=#ffffff>After some effort, you convince the Fatui guard to go "take a break" elsewhere...</color>
Quest Objective: Talk to the girl
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> You two...! If it hadn't been you, I'd have snagged the Proof of the Cognoscenti and gotten away by now! And... you also stole my—
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Woah, calm down! Things were chaotic back then and we didn't mean to take anything from you. And see? We're here to return it to its rightful owner.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> A—Anyway, we'll return it to you right now... Uh, how should we do that?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Could you open the door?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> She probably can't... Maybe we should just leave it here...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Since you can see us, we'll just leave it here.</color>
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> ...You can't be serious. What is this cold indifference you're showing to a fair damsel in distress!? If it were Reed Miller, he would have rescued me in a heartbeat.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: ...Fair damsel?</color>
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> A—Am I not one?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: My name is not Reed Miller.</color>
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> Of course you're not, hmph. No one in our time is his equal.
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> Hmm... You're also here for the Proof of the Cognoscenti, right? How about this — you help me get out of here, and I'll consider sharing some clues with you.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> I think we'll do just fine without your clues.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> That's right. We can find our own way! We're very experienced in that department.
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> Huh? W—Wait, don't go! Then, how... how about information on Raskolnikov? Poruchik Raskolnikov. They say he's quite somebody here.
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> Though wreaking havoc here wouldn't be a bad play... It'd be just like how Reed Miller ransacked the governor's palace, took back the Sampo Mill, and stole the heart of the governor's daughter...
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> ...Ahem! Anyway, I—I mean, it would be in your interest to claim your treasure with grace, no? The information I have will definitely help!
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> P—Please, I beg you, please help me! If Raskolnikov learns that I'm here... I...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What do you say, Traveler? Should we help her?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: We're already here, may as well.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: I guess we can do it for the intel...</color>
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> Hah! Splendid! Today really is my lucky day! Now, I've already swiped an ID card off the guards earlier, so I just need the other one, and we'll be set!
Quest Objective: Find a way to rescue the girl
Optional Dialogue: Talk to ???
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> I don't know where the other card is... but even if you find it, there's still the problem of getting it inside and placing it high up to remove the barrier.
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> It boggles my mind why the Fatui would invent such a strange device...
Quest Objective: Talk to the girl
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> I didn't expect it to go so smoothly... I even got something as powerful as the Moonstriders. I'm sure they'll come in handy later.
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> Speaking of, you aren't bad at all. Maybe just a bit shy of Reed Miller's level, even though we look the same age... And is that a chatty fae next to you?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Paimon's not fae! Paimon's Paimon, Traveler's companion and guide.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Also, why do you keep comparing us to some thief? We're properly registered adventurers!
<color=#ffffff>???:</color> Eh? Were you commissioned by the Adventurers' Guild to come here, then? Hmm, so you weren't... Makes sense, she did say she only told me.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Well, this isn't exactly a commission from the Adventurers' Guild... Also, why are you getting so nosy? You haven't even told us your name, that's not fair at all.
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> Name? Call me Netochka. Soon enough though, I'll be known as the reincarnation of the legendary thief Reed Miller, heir to the Great Treasure — Netochka, the Thief Extraordinaire! Hehe.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: I think "Honorary Knight" sounds better.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Thief Extraordinaire is cool and all, but "Honorary Knight" just has that righteous ring to it. And... it makes Paimon happy to think about the old friends who use this title!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: I'm the hero who saved the city from the evil dragon.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> Well, I've heard stories like that, though they sound more like things children would enjoy?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: My title would leave you quaking in your boots.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> Oh! I get it, you're just trying to act tough. It's fine to be a nobody, as long as you make something of yourself later, like me!
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> Anyway... You're not here for a commission, and you don't like Reed Miller, so why are you interested in the Proof of the Cognoscenti?
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> ...Ahh, is this about the Great Treasure? No romance or destiny involved, just here for the loot?
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: My destiny does not lie here.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: I'm a practical person.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What about you then? Aren't you here for the treasure?
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> Heh heh, well, I must say...
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> "I kindly ask you to return the Sampo Mill, and all other ill-gotten gains stolen from the Frostmoon Scions, right this instant!"
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> "Remember, Nod-Krai is our Elysium, and we need neither gods nor pompous lords here!"
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wow, what are you doing?
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> Haven't you read "The Legends of Reed Miller, Thief Extraordinaire"? *sigh* Never mind. Of course you haven't. I mean, who wouldn't fall for him after reading that?
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> I came across this book when I was still in Novokitezhgrad... From that moment on, I knew my mission.
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> Upon my arrival in Nasha Town, the very first person I met gave me a clue regarding the Proof of the Cognoscenti — that's destiny for sure!
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> Just as the oppressive, greedy governor here stole treasures from the Frostmoon Scions all those years ago, the Fatui now have seized things that don't belong to them.
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> I must retrieve the Proof of the Cognoscenti from them and find Reed Miller's Great Treasure, so that his name, now forgotten, will be held in esteem once more throughout the world!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Uh...
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Um...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: So you're a die-hard Reed Miller fan.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> Th—There's nothing wrong with that!
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> And just like how Reed Miller had his trusty companions Shadow Weasel and Wagtail, your unexpected arrival must also be fate.
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> Otherwise, I'd probably still be stuck there, even if you hadn't taken my treasure.
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hmm? So what exactly is this treasure you're talking about?
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> It's a thief's starter kit that someone sold me at a "heartbreaking discount." However, none of the doors here have keyholes, so it's completely useless.
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> That person was like a prophet from the old tales. She seemed to know everything about me and my intentions at first glance...
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> Not only did she prepare everything I needed, but she also pointed the way forward for me... just for me.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler:</color> Even Paimon wouldn't fall for that...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What do you mean "Even Paimon wouldn't fall for that"!? But you're right. All that "heartbreaking discount" and exclusive information stuff sounds like a scam...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wait a minute, did you get all your intel from her? That's not reliable info at all!
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> That can't be... She was so sincere, there's no way she was lying! Hmm... You just haven't met her yet, I think. When we get back to Nasha Town, I'll introduce you.
<color=#ffffff>Netochka:</color> As for Raskolnikov... Well, Poruchik Raskolnikov, I do know him. We knew each other back in Novokitezhgrad.
